voiceSamples: We track our whole business in real-time so when you have questions or concerns, we have answers and solutions.
We appreciate you visiting our site for pest control, fun and education.
We hope you enjoy this page and discover more about the fascinating world of insects and small wildlife.
Our approach is based on using the most eco friendly methods possible to ensure that your family is not exposed to harsh chemicals that can affect your family’s health and the environment as a whole.

testimonials.quote: Every tech that comes out is great. No more damn ants! We are on a bimonthly and it's worth it!!!
testimonials.author: Daniel Basques

testimonials.quote: I had a good experience with this company at every touch point - from scheduling, to the inspection, to the actual service being performed. I would recommend them again.
testimonials.author: Alex Tiberi

testimonials.quote: We've been working with Planet Orange since first seeing evidence of termites in our place back in 2016. We rest easy knowing they'll treat when we see signs of termites, and their annual inspection will find and treat any termites we don't see. Thanks to our most recent tech, Kirk, for his timely, professional, knowledgeable, friendly and efficient service last week. Thanks to Meghin and Lydia for answering my questions about scheduling and warranty renewal. I recommend Planet Orange to everyone, especially my neighbors!
testimonials.author: Katherine M. Puglisi

testimonials.quote: This place is amazing came out and helped me with our problem. I would highly recommend this company
testimonials.author: Karmeisha Taylor

communityAndValues: Here at Planet Orange, we are dedicated to developing effective, eco-friendly pest control solutions that are sustainable for you, your community, and the planet.
As a leading provider of pest control in the Greater Bay Area and beyond, we believe that the places where you live, work, and play should be as safe and green as possible.
Our approach is based on using the most eco friendly methods possible to ensure that your family is not exposed to harsh chemicals that can affect your family’s health and the environment as a whole.
Planet Orange has been doing eco-friendly business since before eco-friendly was a trending term.
Locally owned and operated for over 15 years, Planet Orange has always strived to help you make your living, working and play spaces safer and healthier for everyone in the community.
